name: WABOT-2
summary: A 'specialist' humanoid built by Waseda to play a keyboard instrument: it read a printed musical score with a camera, then played an electronic organ with ten fingers and two feet, keeping time and even accompanying a singer. WABOT-2 showed that artistic, dexterous tasks were a useful forcing function for humanoid design.
notable: Sight-read sheet music and played an organ with hands and feet (1984)
Early demonstration of real-time dexterous humanoid performance
